subject: Regarding Your Recent Job Application
body: Dear [Applicant Name], Thank you for applying for the [Job Title] position at our company. We have received your application and wanted to inform you that the recruitment process is currently underway. We will be conducting interviews in the next two weeks and will notify all shortlisted candidates via email. Your qualifications and experience are impressive, and we look forward to potentially working with you. If you have any further questions, feel free to reach out. Best regards, [Company Name]
